title: pricing.json (model price snapshot for the usage ledger)

source.priceOfRecord: newapi owns the price of record (LTS biz/newapi.md I1–I3); this snapshot is an engine-side ESTIMATE

notes: NO version field of the data-file kind: `version` here is the PRICE SNAPSHOT version (a date/label from the price source), and it is copied into every ledger row that was priced with it — an old row is never re-priced.
A model absent from `models` is NOT priced as 0: the ledger writes priced_by="unpriced" and cost.total=null (never a silent zero).
A missing or unparsable file is an EMPTY table: every model is unpriced; the reason is reported on stderr and never thrown.
The engine only computes tokens/1e6 × unit price. Group multipliers, expressions and cache-discount algebra stay on the platform side (no second billing implementation).

effective_from.description: unix seconds the snapshot is effective from

currency.description: display currency of every unit price (no conversion is ever done)

unit.description: the only unit the engine understands (price per million tokens)

in.description: price of one UNCACHED prompt token; the provider's prompt_tokens already contains the cache-hit region, which is priced by cache_read only

cache_read.description: price of one cache-HIT (cache-read) token; charged once, never on top of the `in` price

source.description: where the snapshot came from (P1 sync script): kind/ref/synced_at
